verdict_reason: Correctly maps the exchanged document without issuer, but the whole v0.4.0 mapper tree is a copy of v0.3.0 with a one-field difference.

todos.issue: The v0.4.0 mapping is a verbatim copy of v0.3.0 apart from one field. diff against the V3 files shows PimsCommonMapperV4, PimsConsignmentMapperV4, PimsLineItemMapperV4 and PimsTransportMapperV4 differ only in class names and gbnagv4 imports; PimsEventMapperV4 only in the version constants; and of the 24 pims/gbnagv4 records only PimsExchangedDocument differs from gbnagv3 (no 'PimsTradeParty issuer'). Every mapping rule (subdivision-of-origin filter, trade party, address, line items, transport) now has two homes, and v0.1.0/v0.2.0 already add more. A fix to one rule must now be made in up to four places.
todos.fix: Must: each mapping rule that v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 share has one owner; only the exchanged-document difference (no issuer) lives per version. One way: have v0.4.0 reuse the gbnagv3 records and PimsConsignmentMapperV3/PimsCommonMapperV3 for everything except PimsExchangedDocument and PimsGbnAgData, so PimsGbnAgDataMapperV4 delegates to PimsConsignmentMapperV3, and delete PimsCommonMapperV4, PimsConsignmentMapperV4, PimsLineItemMapperV4, PimsTransportMapperV4, the 22 identical gbnagv4 records and their copied tests.
